stemMd: What evidence supports the existence of reciprocal risk sharing?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Letters describing joint compensation following a storm.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Proof that no specialist insurer operated locally.

options.label: D
options.textMd: An absence of storms near the coast.

options.label: E
options.textMd: A complete list of all uninsured voyages.

explanationMd: The correspondence directly describes participants sharing losses. It supports the alternative institution without determining every voyage’s arrangement.

distractorRationale.d: A storm is part of the supporting evidence.
distractorRationale.a: No uniform premium finding is reported.
distractorRationale.c: Specialist insurers and their ledgers are present.
